title: PREFLIGHT-PT: code for compiled-circuit Clifford probes on QAOA workloads

creators.name: Vishwakarma, Aishwarya
creators.affiliation: Department of Quantum Matter Physics, University of Geneva

description:
Code-only release of the Python scripts for constructing, submitting and analysing compiled-circuit Clifford probes and QAOA workload experiments on IBM Heron processors, supporting the article Compiled-circuit Clifford probes predict QAOA performance beyond calibration scores on superconducting processors (A. Vishwakarma, University of Geneva, 2026).

Version 1.0.1 adds, to the registered pipeline of version 1.0.0: the corrected output pairing as a builder option (--output-pairing; the default reproduces the executed circuits), the recovery of the readout-pair statistic from the executed measurements (probe_pairing_check.py), and the analysis scripts for the variants of the statistic, the direct-sampling comparison, the paired comparisons and the noise-model simulation (ablations.py, paired72.py, sim_noise_models.py, make_extra_tables.py).

Research data are not included. The derived per-edge correlator record and the analysis tables accompany the article as Supplementary Data; the raw record is available from the author on request.
